fonte: The Panama Canal, Annual Report of the Governor, FY 1920
legenda: "Gold roll" and "silver roll" were the Zone government's own payroll names.
nota: Relido: "The force for the month of June, 1920, consisted of 4,608 employees on the gold roll and 17,023 on the silver roll" e "a total of 21,631 actually working". Canal e Panama Railroad, força no istmo (não só moradores da Zona). Gold = 21,3 % (conta nossa).
status_conferencia: conferido_primario (cópia local da fonte primária, relida nesta tarefa)
